metadata.description: Official Wisply plugins for Claude Code: read your Wisply memos from the Mac that runs Wisply.

plugins.name: wisply-local
plugins.description: Read-only access to your Wisply memos, transcript excerpts, live transcript and action items from Claude Code on the Mac running Wisply, plus a status line and quote button for live recordings. Talks only to the Wisply app on 127.0.0.1.
